props.name: magnets
props.description: Controlled magnets. Positions are fractions of the frame, so they survive a resize.

props.name: defaultMagnets
props.description: Magnets for uncontrolled use. Defaults to two bars with their north ends facing, which shows a neutral point.

props.name: onMagnetsChange
props.description: Called with the new magnets whenever one is dragged, turned or moved with the keyboard.

props.name: filings
props.description: Number of filings. 2,000–5,000 reads best; capped at 12,000.

props.name: showFilings
props.description: Draw the filings. The built-in toggles change it locally; a new prop value wins.

props.name: showFieldLines
props.description: Draw field lines traced from the poles. The built-in toggles change it locally; a new prop value wins.

props.name: showStrength
props.description: Shade the frame by field strength. The built-in toggles change it locally; a new prop value wins.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Magnets can be dragged, turned and moved with the keyboard. Off, they are part of the picture.

props.name: tone
props.description: Filing colour: the ink token or the accent.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the filings where they are. Magnets still move, and lines and shading still follow them.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width over height of the frame.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the picture. Without it the canvas is decorative and hidden.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the layer toggles, the pause switch and the shake button.
